info.title: Fidelity browser API — reconstructed reference
info.description: Unofficial partial contract derived from the adapter, live read validation, and saved public client code. This is not Fidelity Swagger or a complete server schema. Synthetic fixtures only. Authentication remains in Chrome.

x-authentication: Existing signed-in Chrome session, credentials include, runtime CSRF tokens. No reusable credentials in this reference.

get.description: Session-bound HTML/text containing runtime configuration. Parse expected quoted fields; do not execute downloaded script.

post.description: Plain JSON REST operation, not a GraphQL envelope. Fixed cumulative time-weighted pretax net returns for four standard periods. Preserve provider metadata; missing periods are not zero. Rates are percent units.

Plain JSON REST operation. The response aggregates acctList without echoing account identities. Our tool calls one account at a time and fails on provider system messages or incomplete history. Historical values include cash flows and overnight prices; balance change is not return.

Uses runtime positions bootstrap and X-CSRF-Token. Build security metadata from a freshly scoped positions response. Read every page with stable totals, reject loops, duplicate lot indices and count mismatches. Adjusted basis; no lot reassignment or other writes.
